body: Pension plans, insurance companies, asset managers and family offices from North America, Europe and Asia backed PennantPark Investment Advisers’ latest senior credit fund, which closed above its original target with $1.2 billion in investable capital. The final closing of PennantPark Senior Credit Fund II (PSCF II) brings the firm’s capital raised across two recent transactions […]
